messages:
jamie (partnerships): FYI I just got a message from Marketplace SME — they need a SOC2 summary, a high-level pen-test result summary, and answers to a short security questionnaire before the listing review next Wednesday. Deadline they gave: EOD Friday. Can we pull together what they want? :eyes:

viv (security): I can draft the SOC2 executive summary and a sanitized pen-test highlights doc. Need to confirm which pen-test (internal vs third-party) they expect. Do we have an approved redacted report we can share?

ravi (eng-runtime): We have a third-party pentest from Q4 2024 (scope: inference control plane + console). Findings were mostly medium/low; fixes tracked in CH-2234. I can extract the high-level remediation timeline. Any redaction rules?

viv (security): Redact IP addresses, customer IDs, and any snippet of logs. Keep vulnerability IDs, severity, and remediation status. Also include the engagement name (Cobalt) and date. I'll prepare a one-page summary.

anna (legal): Double-check NDA terms — some reports are covered by the pen-test vendor NDA. If the vendor requires a data sharing agreement, we may need a quick addendum. I'll review the contract today.

jamie (partnerships): Thanks all. Marketplace questions attached in the thread below (copied from their form):

```
1) Do you have a SOC2 report? (Y/N) - If Y, attach summary and scope.
2) Has your product undergone a third-party penetration test in the last 12 months? (Y/N) - If Y, attach executive summary.
3) Describe your data encryption at-rest and in-transit.
4) Do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?
5) Any open critical/major vulnerabilities in the last 90 days? (Y/N) - If Y, explain.
6) Provide contact for security review and point-of-contact for follow-ups.
```

ravi (eng-runtime): For #3: we use AES-256 at-rest with envelope encryption; TLS1.2+ for in-flight and mutual-TLS for private deployments. For #4: yes — we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations and HSM options for Private. I'll draft short answers.

viv (security): I'll upload the SOC2 exec summary (non-attachable here — will drop a link once ready) and the redacted pen-test highlights. Who can approve the redaction? @anna?

anna (legal): I can approve the redaction. If ops-bot flags any vendor restrictions, ping me.

ops-bot: Document created: https://internal.redwood.com/marketplace/compliance/1758123456-draft (permissions: partnerships, security, legal).

jamie (partnerships): Great — plan: viv to produce SOC2 summary + pen-test highlights, ravi to draft technical answers for encryption/KMS and open vuln statement, anna to sign off on redactions and check vendor NDA. Target: share packet with Marketplace SME by Friday EOD. I'll handle the email template and attachments.

viv (security): I'll have drafts by Thursday noon.

ravi (eng-runtime): I'll send the technical snippets by Wednesday COB.

anna (legal): I'll review redaction by Thursday afternoon.

jamie (partnerships): Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here or DM. Also heads-up: Marketplace may request a quick 30-min security Q&A call — let's keep calendars flexible next Tue/Wed. :calendar:
